subject: Platform-wide: validateFlag cannot distinguish an UNREGISTERED flag id from a WRONG answer
description: Found 2026-08-09 by Chris while gating the Cold Horizon deploy. validateFlag answers a missing flag_registry entry with correct:false and flagId:null, byte-identical to a genuinely wrong answer. LagrangeEngine.submitFlag (and by the same shape BoxEngine) therefore takes the wrong-answer branch, subtracts wrongAnswerPenalty and renders Rejected. A student who solves a mission whose flag is not seeded is told they are WRONG and DOCKED POINTS. Mitigated in le-01-cold-horizon by a client-side per-flag declaration, but that is a hand-maintained mirror of Firestore state and WILL drift. RIGHT FIX is server-side: validateFlag should return a distinguishable result when the box has no registry entry for the submitted id, so no client needs to mirror registry state. Benefits every box. NOTE ops05 Operation Blackwire describes 12 flags in its card text while the card field says 5, so audit which boxes have content beyond their seeded flags.
